Chapter 6665: Let’S See What You Are?

Chapter 6665: Let’s See What You Are?

One bolt pierced her chest, so blood splashed everywhere.

“Death!” She retaliated furiously by slamming her Death Coffin.

The affinity, death, gathered in the single blow. The coffin turned into a world of death. Behind were three thousand worlds of life - a constant cycle to fuel death. Their weight also added to the blow’s severity while time was being ravaged.

Supreme lords became aghast, aware they couldn’t block the move. Sheer power and temporal withering destroyed everything.

“Death Coffin.” Bao Pu’s expression darkened upon seeing this as he became tempted to seize it.

“Bam!” Spectators expected Bao Pu to use an immortal law or another comparable treasure to stop the descending world of death.

However, another hand blocked the coffin and forced the death affinity back inside.

They saw a youth doing so without any difficulty. An immortal treasure might be able to stop it but he used his bare hand effortlessly.

“It’s him!” Godstallion and the others became startled.

Godstallion, in particular, had an unforgettable encounter with Li Qiye. The guy smashed him to pieces and nearly killed him.

“Wh-who is he?” Some emperors and desolate gods didn’t recognize him.

No one saw how he got there as if he were there the entire time without moving. Others just couldn’t see him.

“Your Majesty!” Lord of Life and Death’s eyes lit up with joy upon seeing him.

“Focus on the tribulation, leave this to me.” He smiled.

“Yes.” His gentle words invigorated her battle intent. She became resplendent and life force surged outward.

Previously, others viewed her as the master of death and life was secondary. Now, life surged outward and swept through all dimensions and temporal spheres.

Not even an immortal had such a rich life force. Her life shockwaves pulsed outward and eradicated the lightning bolts.

After seeing this, everyone shared a single thought - an immortal ascension was going to happen.

As for Li Qiye, he turned and gazed at Bao Pu, causing him to become stiff and instinctively stagger one step backward.

He was an immortal and his masters were three legends. He spent a long period with them and had fought against primordial immortals previously with their help. Thus, he didn’t fear immortals.

Now, a forgotten feeling resurfaced upon seeing Li Qiye. He took a deep breath and bowed: “Sacred Teacher, I have long admired you. I apologize for the late meeting due to my illness.”

“Indeed, from chewing immortal corpses.” Li Qiye said.

The sarcastic remark hurt him since this was his heart devil. Nevertheless, he quelled his emotions.

“Sacred Teacher, I walk on a different path...” He said.

“Enough.” Li Qiye frowned and delivered a slap.

Bao Pu immediately grasped the yin and yang along with the reincarnation cycle for a block. Unfortunately, Li Qiye still landed several slaps.

A mighty weapon couldn’t leave a mark on Bao Pu’s face. However, Li Qiye’s barrage made him see stars. His cheeks ached and burned with pain, starting to swell dramatically.

He held his cheeks, feeling both rage and fear.

“Sacred Teacher, thank you for the guidance...” He had never experienced such humiliation before.

“Let’s see what kind of abomination you are.” Li Qiye uttered coldly.

Bao Pu roared and released his immortal light, not holding back his destructive capability in the slightest.

Li Qiye slapped the light and extinguished it. Bao Pu’s grand dao and visual phenomena dispersed, revealing his true form.
